title: The Fed-Up Office Lady Wants to Serve the Villainess
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Temp worker Natori Midori loses her job of three years and is summoned into the world of a game she plays by Lapis Tenebrae, the game's cruel villainess. Pretending her knowledge of the plot is psychic power, Natori saves Lapis from danger, becomes her secretary, sees another side of her, and works to save her from a plot-mandated death while developing feelings for her.
life_message: Devoted, competent service to someone you believe in can give a discarded worker purpose and change another person's fate.

content.note: Fantasy dangers and a foretold death; not described as graphic.
Yuri romance and GL subtext with an age gap between an adult worker and a magic-school student (AniList, MU); MangaDex rates it safe.
Burnout and despair after being laid off start the story.
Natori lies that she is psychic (Wikipedia).
